metadata.title: High-Fashion Editorial Portrait with Modern Serif Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot fashion portrait of a woman with long blonde hair, wearing a dark fur vest and gold accessories, set against a flat, neutral-toned background. The composition is anchored by large, high-contrast serif typography that interacts with the subject's head and arms.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's arms framing the central typography
High-contrast dark clothing against a pale, desaturated background
Vertical alignment between the subject's torso and the central axis of the layout
Text-to-subject layering where the subject appears slightly in front of the lettering
coreInvariants: Subject's pose with arms raised behind the head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, filling the vertical space from the waist up to the top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down the subject's face, follows the texture of the fur vest to the bottom right numeral.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat space on the left and right sides of the subject, creating a clean, studio-like feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy or black (fur vest and typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject's silhouette and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted earth tones and deep blacks

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Acute accent mark on the final 'E' is elongated and sharp

composition.overlap: Subject's arms overlap the bottom of the letters

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and weights for consistency.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant aesthetic of high-fashion editorial design.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs for a dominant display role.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-fashion studio portrait of a woman with long, textured blonde hair, wearing a dark navy fur vest and gold filigree bracelets. She has her arms raised behind her head, looking slightly upward. The background is a flat, desaturated cream color. Lighting is soft but directional, emphasizing the texture of the fur and hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large uppercase word in a high-contrast Modern Serif font across the top of the frame, partially obscured by the subject's arms. Add a single large numeral in the same font style in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Does the subject's pose interact with the top text?
Is the color palette muted and warm-toned?
Is the fur texture clearly visible?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Rich texture in the clothing and hair

postGenerationChecks: Lighting on the subject matches the flat background environment
The numeral in the corner is balanced with the top text
The fur texture does not appear muddy or undefined
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, textured fashion portrait with oversized Didone-style typography that sits behind the subject's extremities, using a desaturated, high-value color palette.
